spin.label: Speed
spin.note: Reactivity drives the magnitude; spin_sign/Flip owns the sign (magnitude_only preserves it on write)

spin_sign.label: Flip
spin_sign.note: On=positive spin, Off=negative spin, Toggle=negate sign

image_location.label: Dance GIF
image_location.note: LedFX asset path (spotfx/dancer/*.gif). ALWAYS patch together with beat_frames

beat_frames.label: Beat Frames
beat_frames.note: Frame indices that land on beats; comes from the gifsmith manifest

handoff_ease.label: Handoff Ease
handoff_ease.note: Seconds adopted particles wind up to full speed after an orbits->blackhole switch

particle_count.label: Particles
particle_count.note: Count changes animate: removed particles fly off, new ones fly in

jiggle.label: Jiggle
jiggle.note: 0 = clean synced orbits, 1 = independent smooth wander + fully decorrelated reactivity

tether_scatter.label: Tether Scatter
tether_scatter.note: 0 = perfectly equidistant tethers, 1 = fully random ring placement

enter_time.label: Enter Time
enter_time.note: Seconds a new or adopted particle glides into its orbit (fly-ins + blackhole->orbits handoff)

reactivity_scale.label: Reactivity
reactivity_scale.note: Master scale; multiplies speed_jump / speed_jog / brightness_audio / size_audio

color_shift.label: Color Jump
color_shift.note: Nudge +1 on a morph to make colors jump A,B,C -> C,A,B

radius_scale.label: Field Radius
radius_scale.note: Sample-ring radius: where along the fall blobs peak

x_offset.label: X Offset
x_offset.note: Rotates the whole pattern around the strip

approach_width.label: Approach Width
approach_width.note: Radial width of the approach/pass/trail brightness envelope

particle_count.label: Particles
particle_count.note: Count changes animate: removed particles fade out, new ones explode in

x_offset.label: X Offset
x_offset.note: Rotates the whole tether ring around the strip

orbit_radius.label: Orbit Radius
orbit_radius.note: Oscillation reach as a fraction of particle spacing

jiggle.label: Jiggle
jiggle.note: 0 = clean synced orbits, 1 = independent smooth wander + fully decorrelated reactivity

tether_scatter.label: Tether Scatter
tether_scatter.note: 0 = perfectly equidistant tethers, 1 = fully random ring placement

reactivity_scale.label: Reactivity
reactivity_scale.note: Master scale; multiplies speed_jump / speed_jog / brightness_audio / size_audio

speed_jog.label: Jog Reverse Chance
speed_jog.note: Chance per spike/beat that the speed jump runs backward (jiggle correlates the rolls)

color_shift.label: Color Jump
color_shift.note: Nudge +1 on a morph to make colors jump A,B,C -> C,A,B

overlap_blend.label: Overlap Blend
overlap_blend.note: Overlapping blobs: 0 = no brightness gain (hue midpoint), 1 = fully additive

bounce_chance.label: Bounce Chance
bounce_chance.note: Chance per spike/beat that a particle bounces and travels backward along the strip

implode_fade.label: Implode Fade
implode_fade.note: Seconds an add-implosion takes: fragments converge while the particle fades in

implode_reach.label: Implode Reach
implode_reach.note: Fraction of the strip away the implosion fragments start

trail_decay.label: Trail Length
trail_decay.note: Forward: comet-trail length. Reverse: how faint and gradual the imploding burst STARTS (its end is always a fast wink-out)

spawn_rate.label: Spawn Rate
spawn_rate.note: Fireworks launched per second; 0 = beat bursts only

beat_burst.label: Beat Burst
beat_burst.note: Extra fireworks launched on each beat

spawn_audio.label: Audio Spawn
spawn_audio.note: How much the chosen band boosts the launch rate

burst_size.label: Burst Size
burst_size.note: Particles per firework; the shared Edge / particle count shape sub-field lands here on fireworks

burst_speed.label: Burst Speed
burst_speed.note: Base explosion speed in radii per second

burst_life.label: Burst Life
burst_life.note: Seconds a particle lives after the explosion

speed_audio.label: Audio Speed
speed_audio.note: How much the music boosts the explosion speed

brightness_audio.label: Audio Brightness
brightness_audio.note: How much the music pumps firework brightness

drag.label: Drag
drag.note: How hard particles decelerate after the burst

gradient.label: Gradient
gradient.note: Each firework picks ONE random color from this gradient for all its particles

reverse.label: Reverse
reverse.note: Implode: particles are born dim at their flight distance and brighten as they converge onto the burst point (same Reverse morph sub-field as Blackhole)

burst_audio.label: Audio Burst Size
burst_audio.note: How much volume grows each firework's particle count; 0 pins it at Burst Size

trail_decay.label: Trail Length
trail_decay.note: Forward: comet-trail length. Reverse: how faint and gradual the imploding burst STARTS (its end is always a fast wink-out)

spawn_rate.label: Spawn Rate
spawn_rate.note: Fireworks (particle pairs) launched per second; 0 = beat bursts only

beat_burst.note: Extra fireworks launched on each beat

spawn_audio.label: Audio Spawn

burst_speed.note: Base separation speed as a fraction of the strip per second

burst_life.label: Burst Life
burst_life.note: Seconds a particle lives after the launch

speed_audio.label: Audio Speed
speed_audio.note: How much the music boosts the separation speed

brightness_audio.label: Audio Brightness
brightness_audio.note: How much the music pumps firework brightness

gradient.label: Gradient
gradient.note: Each firework picks ONE random color from this gradient for both its particles
